column1: 1|17|General principles|面试的五个原则|面试官给出的题目缺少一个会影响答案的假设。按原书面试建议，下面哪种处理最合适？|An interviewer’s problem omits an assumption that affects the answer. Which response best follows the book’s interview guidance?|把知识准备与现场沟通分开思考。|Separate preparation from communication.|扎实掌握数学、金融和编程基础；提前练习典型问题。先听清条件，必要时澄清，再把关键推理说出来。信息不完整时提出合理假设并说明它，而不是默默补上条件。|Build strong fundamentals in mathematics, finance and programming. Practice beforehand, listen carefully, clarify the assumptions and explain the important reasoning steps. When information is missing, state a reasonable assumption explicitly.

2|19|Screwy pirates|海盗分金|五名海盗A至E按资历递减分100枚整金币。提案者也投票，至少半数赞成即通过，否则提案者出局。海盗都理性：先保命，再多拿钱；两项相同时宁愿提案者出局。A提出哪个分配能通过且让自己所得最多？按A、B、C、D、E排列。|Five rational pirates A–E, in seniority order, divide 100 indivisible coins. The proposer votes too; at least half the votes pass the proposal, otherwise the proposer dies. Preferences are survival, then more coins, then killing the proposer if otherwise indifferent. Which passing allocation maximizes A’s coins? Entries are A, B, C, D, E.|从两名海盗开始倒推，比较每个人在下一轮能拿多少。|Work backward from two pirates and price each vote against its next-round payoff.|按资历从高到低记作A、B、C、D、E。两人时D独吞；三人时C给E一枚；四人时B给D一枚。于是五人时C、E在下一轮都得0，A各给他们1枚就能连同自己凑到3票，分配为98、0、1、0、1。关键是严格多于下一轮所得才会换来赞成票。|Label the pirates A through E in decreasing seniority. With two pirates D keeps everything; with three C buys E's vote for one coin; with four B buys D's vote. Thus C and E would get zero if A died. A offers (98,0,1,0,1), obtaining three votes. A bribe must improve the recipient's next-round payoff.

2|20|Tiger and sheep|老虎与羊|岛上有100只老虎和1只羊。老虎可吃草但更想吃羊；一次只能由一只虎吃羊，吃完它就变成羊。所有虎都理性，生存优先于吃羊。下面哪项结论与理由成立？|An island has 100 tigers and one sheep. Tigers can eat grass but prefer sheep; only one tiger eats at a time and the eater becomes a sheep. All are rational and put survival first. Which conclusion and argument are valid?|从1只、2只、3只老虎开始看奇偶规律。|Start with one, two and three tigers and track parity.|1只虎时会吃；2只虎时谁吃谁就会被剩下的虎吃，所以都不吃；3只虎时吃后留下2只虎与1只羊，因而安全。归纳可得：虎数为奇数会吃，为偶数不会吃。100为偶数，羊安全。|One tiger eats; two tigers abstain because the eater would be eaten; three tigers can eat because the resulting two-tiger position is safe. Induction alternates the outcome: an odd number eats and an even number abstains. With 100 tigers the sheep survives.

2|21|River crossing|过桥与手电筒|四人在同一侧过桥，各自单独过桥需1、2、5、10分钟。每次最多两人，同行耗时为较慢者的时间。夜间过桥必须携带唯一手电筒，返回也一样。全部到对岸最少需多少分钟？|Four people start on one side of a bridge and take 1,2,5,10 minutes individually. At most two cross at once, at the slower person’s speed. Every crossing, including returns, requires their single torch. What is the minimum total time in minutes?|让两个最慢的人一起走，安排快的人送回手电。|Send the two slowest together and use the fastest as couriers.|1和2先过，用2分钟；1返回，用1分钟；5和10一起过，用10分钟；2返回，用2分钟；1和2再过，用2分钟。总计17分钟。若总让1分钟的人护送每位慢者，会花19分钟。|Send 1 and 2 across (2), return 1 (1), send 5 and 10 (10), return 2 (2), then send 1 and 2 (2). The total is 17 minutes. Pairing the slowest travelers avoids paying the ten-minute crossing separately twice.

2|21|Birthday problem|生日的逻辑推断|候选生日是3月4/5/8日、6月4/7日、9月1/5日、12月1/2/8日。甲只知月份，乙只知几号，两人都知道候选表且推理正确。甲说：“我不知道，且知道乙也不知道。”乙说：“原来不知道，现在知道了。”甲说：“现在我也知道了。”生日是哪一天？|Possible birthdays are Mar 4/5/8, Jun 4/7, Sep 1/5, Dec 1/2/8. A knows only the month and B only the day; both know the list and reason correctly. A: “I do not know, and I know B does not know.” B: “I did not know, but now I do.” A: “Now I know too.” What is the birthday?|每句话都在删除与该说法不相容的候选项。|Each knowledge statement eliminates incompatible candidate dates.|知道月份的人确信知道日期的人不知道，排除包含唯一日期7或2的6月、12月。知道日期的人随后知道答案，排除剩下重复的5日，只剩3月4日、3月8日、9月1日。知道月份的人此时也能确定，因此只能是9月1日。|The month-holder knows the day-holder cannot identify the date, ruling out June and December, which contain unique days 7 and 2. The day-holder then identifies the date, eliminating day 5. The remaining dates are March 4, March 8 and September 1. Only September lets the month-holder identify a unique date, so the answer is September 1.

2|22|Card game|红黑牌的不变量|标准52张牌有26红26黑。洗牌后每次翻两张，红红归你、黑黑归庄家、混色丢弃，直至牌用完。你的牌严格多于庄家才获100元，否则0元。忽略其他效用，风险中性者最多应付多少入场费？|A standard deck has 26 red and 26 black cards. Turn over pairs: red-red goes to you, black-black to the dealer, mixed pairs are discarded. After all cards, you receive 100 only if your pile is strictly larger, otherwise zero. What is the maximum risk-neutral entry fee?|记住红牌总数等于黑牌总数。|Track the equal totals of red and black cards.|每次混色丢弃都同时删去一红一黑，剩下红、黑数量仍相等。最终你拿到的红牌必然与庄家黑牌一样多。严格多才算你赢，因此不可能赢，不应支付正入场费。|Discarding a mixed pair removes exactly one red and one black card. Equality of the remaining totals is invariant. At the end your red total equals the dealer's black total, so you never win under the strict-win rule and should pay no positive entry fee.

2|23|Burning ropes|烧绳计时|两根绳子各烧完需1小时，燃烧速度不均匀。如何量出45分钟？|Two ropes each take one hour to burn but burn unevenly. How can you measure 45 minutes?|两端同时点燃，烧完时间会减半，不需要均匀燃烧。|Lighting both ends halves the remaining burn time without requiring uniform speed.|同时点燃第一根两端、第二根一端。第一根烧尽时经过30分钟；此时第二根还需单端烧30分钟。再点燃它的另一端，剩余部分15分钟烧完。合计45分钟。|Light both ends of the first rope and one end of the second. When the first finishes, 30 minutes have elapsed and the second has 30 minutes of burn time left. Light its other end; it finishes in 15 more minutes, for a total of 45.

2|23|Defective ball|十二球称重|12颗外观相同的球中恰有1颗异常，可能偏重也可能偏轻，其余等重。只有能显示左重、平衡或右重的天平。要在最坏情况下确定异常球并判断轻重，最少称几次？|Exactly one of 12 identical-looking balls has a different weight, either heavier or lighter. All others have equal weight. A balance reports left-heavy, balanced or right-heavy. What is the minimum worst-case number of weighings to identify the ball and its direction?|每次称重有三种结果，需要同时管理球号和偏重、偏轻两种假设。|A weighing has three outcomes. Track both ball identity and heavy/light hypotheses.|至少需3次，因为2次最多9种结果，不能区分12颗×轻重共24种假设。三次可达：先称1234与5678。若平衡，称9、10、11与1、2、3；再用9与10或12与1区分。若左重，嫌疑为1–4偏重或5–8偏轻，第二次称125与346：左重只剩1重、2重、6轻，称1与2；右重只剩3重、4重、5轻，称3与4；平衡只剩7轻、8轻，称7与8。首称右重时把“重/轻”对换，同一分组同样有效。每个分支至多3次。|At least three weighings are needed: two have at most nine outcomes for 24 ball/direction hypotheses. Weigh 1234 against 5678. If balanced, weigh 9,10,11 against known-normal 1,2,3; compare 9 with 10 if unbalanced, or 12 with 1 if balanced. If the first weighing is left-heavy, the suspects are 1–4 heavy or 5–8 light. Weigh 125 against 346. Left-heavy leaves 1-heavy,2-heavy,6-light: compare 1 with 2. Right-heavy leaves 3-heavy,4-heavy,5-light: compare 3 with 4. Balanced leaves 7-light or 8-light: compare 7 with 8. If the first result is right-heavy, reverse heavy/light labels; the same groupings work. Every branch uses at most three weighings.

2|25|Trailing zeros|阶乘的末尾零|100! = 1×2×…×100 的十进制表示末尾有多少个连续的0？|How many trailing zeros are in the decimal representation of 100! = 1×2×…×100?|一个零来自一对2和5，哪个素因子更稀缺？|Each zero needs a factor 2 and a factor 5. Count the scarcer factor.|2的因子多于5，所以只数5。5的倍数贡献20个，25的倍数再贡献4个，125以上没有。共24个。一般公式为Σ floor(n/5^k)。|Factors of two are more abundant, so count factors of five: floor(100/5)+floor(100/25)=20+4=24. Higher powers contribute zero. In general the count is the sum of floor(n/5^k) over positive k.

2|25|Horse race|二十五匹马|25匹马速度恒定且互不相同，每场最多5匹，只知道名次，没有计时器。要保证识别全体最快的3匹，最坏情况下最少安排几场比赛？|25 horses have distinct constant speeds. At most five race at once; only ranks are observed, with no timer. What is the minimum worst-case number of races to identify the three fastest?|先建立组内偏序，再淘汰至少已有三匹马更快的候选者。|Rank within groups and eliminate any horse already known to have three faster rivals.|先分5组各赛一次；第6场让5位组冠军比赛，按A、B、C、D、E排序。A1最快，仍可能占第2、第3的只有A2、A3、B1、B2、C1，让它们进行第7场即可。总共7场。|Run five heats, then race their winners. Name the groups A through E by that result. A1 is fastest overall. Only A2, A3, B1, B2 and C1 can still be second or third; race them once. Seven races suffice, with every other horse eliminated by three known faster horses.

2|26|Infinite sequence|无限幂塔|正实数x的无限幂塔x^(x^(x^…))已知收敛到2。x等于多少？|For positive real x, the infinite tower x^(x^(x^…)) is known to converge to 2. What is x?|去掉最外层后，剩余幂塔的极限仍为2。|The inner tower has the same limit as the entire tower.|设极限y=2，由自相似得到y=x^y，故2=x²，正实数解x=√2。还要核对收敛性，不能对任意x都假设无限幂塔存在；√2在实数幂塔的收敛范围内。|Let the limit be y=2. Self-similarity gives y=x^y, so x²=2 and the positive solution is √2. The limit assumption matters: not every positive base yields a convergent tower. This base lies in the real convergence range.

2|26|Box packing|三维装砖|把1×1×4砖沿整数单位网格方向放入6×6×6盒子，砖不可重叠。用2×2×2小块作棋盘染色：两色分别14块与13块，每根砖占每色各2单位体积。哪项正确证明53根放不下？|Place 1×1×4 bricks on the integer grid inside a 6×6×6 box, without overlap. Checkerboard-color the 2×2×2 blocks: 14 of one color,13 of the other. Each brick occupies volume 2 of each color. Which valid bound rules out 53 bricks?|体积足够未必能装下；尝试把2×2×2小块交替染色。|Volume is insufficient as a proof. Color alternating 2×2×2 blocks.|盒子包含27个2×2×2块，两色分别14块、13块。每根沿网格的1×1×4砖对两色各占2单位体积。较少颜色仅有13×8=104单位体积，最多支持52根砖，因此53根不可能。这个论证依赖题目中的网格摆放设定。|Checkerboard-color the 27 blocks of size 2×2×2. One color occupies 13 blocks, hence volume 104. Every grid-aligned brick occupies two units of each color, so at most 104/2=52 bricks fit. Thus 53 cannot fit under the grid-alignment assumption.

2|27|Calendar cubes|日历方块|两个六面方块每面标一位数字，每次各露一面，需显示所有01到31。允许交换左右，并允许把6倒转当9。下面哪组标法可行？|Label each face of two cubes with one digit. Display all dates 01–31 using one face of each cube. Cubes may swap sides; a 6 may be inverted as 9. Which labeling works?|11和22要求两块都有1和2；6可以翻转成9。|Both cubes need 1 and 2; a rotated 6 can serve as 9.|两块都标0、1、2；一块余下面标3、4、5，另一块标6、7、8。把6倒过来当9。这样12个面覆盖所有所需日期。|Label one cube 0,1,2,3,4,5 and the other 0,1,2,6,7,8. Rotate 6 to represent 9. Duplicating 0,1,2 makes the repeated and single-digit dates possible while the remaining faces cover the other digits.

2|28|Door to offer|真假守卫|两扇门分别通向录用和出口，每门一守卫，一人永远说真话，一人永远说假话，二人都知道门的去向。你可向任意一人问一个是非问题：“另一位会说你守的门通往录用吗？”应如何根据回答选门？|Two doors lead to an offer and an exit, each with a guard. One always tells truth, one always lies, and both know the doors. Ask either guard one yes/no question: “Would the other guard say your door leads to the offer?” How should you choose?|把另一个守卫的回答嵌套进问题。|Nest the other guard's answer inside the question.|问任一守卫：“另一位守卫会说你守的门通往录用吗？”若答是，选另一门；若答否，选该守卫身后的门。无论问到谁，嵌套一次谎言都把真相反转。|Ask either guard: “Would the other guard say your door leads to the offer?” If yes, choose the other door; if no, choose this door. The nested answer contains exactly one lie, so it reverses the truth in either case.

2|29|Message delivery|双锁传信|文件需放在可同时挂两把独立锁的箱子里邮寄。快递会取走未上锁箱内的一切，但不会破锁或调换箱子。你和收件人各有一把锁，各自持唯一钥匙。未交换钥匙时，哪项流程能让对方安全拿到文件？|A document travels in a box that can hold two independent padlocks at once. The courier steals contents of unlocked boxes but does not break locks or substitute boxes. Each party owns a lock and its only key. Without sending keys, which sequence securely delivers the document?|允许同一箱子同时挂两把锁。|Allow two padlocks on the same box.|你上自己的锁寄出；对方不拆你的锁，再加自己的锁寄回；你拆自己的锁再寄出；对方用自己的钥匙开箱。三次运输全程至少有一把锁。这里依赖箱子能挂两锁以及讨论范围内的快递威胁模型。|Lock the box and send it. The recipient adds a second lock and returns it. Remove your lock and send it again; the recipient removes theirs. Three deliveries suffice, and the box is never unlocked in transit. The construction assumes the box supports two locks and the stated courier model.

2|29|Last ball|最后一颗球|袋中初始20蓝14红。每次取出并移走两球：同色就补入1蓝球，异色就补入1红球；补球充足。重复至仅剩1球。最后颜色是什么？|Start with 20 blue and 14 red balls. Remove two each step: if their colors match, insert one blue; otherwise insert one red. Replacement balls are unlimited. Repeat until one remains. What is its color?|观察红球数量的奇偶性。|Track the parity of the number of red balls.|红球数量每次减少0或2，所以始终为偶数。每步总球数减少1，最后只有一球；它不可能是红球，否则红球数为1。故最后为蓝球。|The red count changes only by zero or minus two, preserving even parity. The total count falls by one each step. With one ball left the red count cannot be one, so the final ball must be blue.

2|30|Light switches|四个开关|房外4个开关初始都关，恰1个控制房内灯泡。可任意预先操作，进房前看不到灯。假设通电足够久会有可辨余热，关灯后余热保留，刚开时尚冷；进房可辨亮灭和冷热。最少进房几次能确定开关？|Four initially-off switches are outside a room; exactly one controls its bulb. You may operate them before entering, but cannot see the bulb outside. Assume a long-on bulb is detectably hot, heat persists after switch-off, and a newly-lit bulb remains cool initially. Inside you can distinguish light and heat. Minimum entries needed?|除了亮灭，还可以利用灯泡余热；先确认灯泡会发热。|Use heat as well as light, assuming a bulb with detectable retained heat.|先让A、B开足够久，再关B、开C，D始终关。立刻进房：亮且热对应A，灭且热对应B，亮且冷对应C，灭且冷对应D。一次即可；若灯泡不产生可辨余热，该策略不成立。|Warm the bulb using A and B, then switch B off and C on, leaving D off. Enter promptly: lit/hot means A, dark/hot B, lit/cold C, dark/cold D. One visit suffices if heat is detectable and switching is timed appropriately; an effectively heatless bulb invalidates this construction.

2|31|Quant salary|不公开工资求平均|8人只想公布平均工资。假设每人仅看传给自己的数，不串通；第1人把随机掩码R加到自己的工资上，依次私下传递，每人再加自己的工资。第8人把总数T传回第1人。应公布哪个平均数？|Eight people want only the mean salary published. Assume no collusion and private handoffs. Person 1 adds a private random mask R to their salary; each person adds their salary to the running total. Person 8 returns total T to person 1. Which value should be published?|先用随机数遮住第一人的工资，再依次累加。|Mask the first salary with a random offset and circulate a running sum.|第一人取随机数R，加上自己的工资后传给第二人；每人加上自己的工资，最后传回第一人。第一人减去R，公布总额并除以8。这是题目假设下的简单遮蔽法，不保证抵御参与者串通。|The first person adds a random mask R to their salary and passes the sum around. Everyone adds their salary. The first person subtracts R from the returned total and divides by eight. This hides direct disclosure under the puzzle's assumptions but is not secure against colluding participants.

2|31|Coin piles|盲分硬币|1000枚硬币中恰有20枚正面朝上，蒙眼无法辨别正反。如何分成两堆，使正面数相同？|Among 1,000 coins exactly 20 show heads. Blindfolded, split them into two piles with equal numbers of heads.|可以翻转一整堆，不必识别哪枚朝上。|Flip an entire selected pile rather than trying to identify individual heads.|任取20枚作第一堆，假设其中有h枚正面，则另一堆有20−h枚正面。把第一堆全部翻转，它也恰有20−h枚正面。两堆总枚数无需相同。|Choose any 20 coins. If h are heads, the other pile contains 20−h heads. Flip all 20 chosen coins; that pile now also has 20−h heads. The piles need equal head counts, not equal total sizes.

2|32|Mislabeled bags|全部贴错的水果袋|三袋分别是纯苹果、纯橘子、苹果橘子混合。三个标签“苹果”“橘子”“混合”全部贴错。每次可指定一袋取出1个水果并看种类。保证辨认所有袋子，最少需取几个水果？|Three bags contain apples only, oranges only, and a mixture. Labels “apples”,“oranges”,“mixed” are all wrong. You may choose a bag and inspect one fruit per draw. What is the minimum number of draws that guarantees identifying all bags?|从标为“混合”的袋子抽一个，它一定不是混合袋。|Draw from the bag labeled “mixed”; it must be a pure bag.|只需一次。若从“混合”袋抽到苹果，则该袋是纯苹果；标“橘子”的袋不能是橘子，也不能是已确定的苹果，只能是混合；最后一袋是橘子。抽到橘子时对称处理。|One draw suffices. If the “mixed” bag yields an apple, it is the all-apple bag. The bag labeled “oranges” must then be mixed because both its label and the apple identity are excluded. The last bag is oranges. Reverse the roles if the first draw is an orange.

2|33|Wise men|贤者与翻杯子|50人事先商量后隔离，每次随机召见一人；每人会被反复召见，杯子初始底朝下。指定1人为计数者，其他人只在杯子底朝下且自己从未发信号时翻转，计数者见杯反向就复位并加1。计数到多少时能安全宣布所有人都来过？|50 people agree on a strategy before isolation. Each is revisited repeatedly, with one cup initially upright. Designate one counter. Each other person turns the cup over only once, when it is upright; the counter resets an overturned cup and increments the count. At what count can the counter safely announce that all have visited?|指定一个计数者，其余人每人只发一次信号。|Designate one counter; everyone else signals exactly once.|49名普通人只在杯子处于初始方向且自己从未发信号时翻杯。计数者每见杯子反向，就复位并加1，数到49即可宣布。若每人都会反复被召见，完成概率为1；不是任意有限时间内必然完成。|Each of the 49 non-counters flips the cup from the initial position only once in their life.
